correctness.rationale: Full proof reconstructed with finite free-action hypothesis and right-to-left function composition. Four natural-conjugacy equations are equivalent to equivariant image conjugacy because freeness allows extending both intertwining witnesses from images. Gauge equations on image-orbit digraphs eliminate every off-cycle label and leave one conjugacy class of the ordered multiplier per directed cycle, including for nonabelian groups. A restricted digraph is realizable on m orbits iff number of its vertices plus its source count is at most m. The formally recursive rooted-tree series and cycle-index calculation give the exact Euler product; all products are coefficientwise finite. Standard-library checker exhaustively verifies all 10,296 distinct unordered pairs in End_{S3}(S3×[2]) against the original four equations and all transformations on up to five orbits for trivial G. Finite calculations support but are not relied upon for infinite proof.

value.rationale: The precise nonabelian finite-free-G-set case is naturally motivated by a published explicit open problem in arXiv:2301.04252, Problem 7.4. The gauge classification goes beyond the abelian-only earlier theorem, and the exact Euler product determines a complete infinite rank-by-rank invariant depending only on the number of ordinary group conjugacy classes. The r+s realization threshold is a structural enumerative ingredient necessary for the answer, not a gratuitous finite slice; nonfree G-sets form a meaningful remaining boundary.
